messages:
Aisha (PM): Heads-up — FinCorp just pushed an urgent ask for a private Dedicated + on‑prem style rollout with KMS and SOC2-grade audit logs. Wants a 6‑week timeline. Need a quick call on prioritization.
Lee (Eng Lead): What exactly are they asking for scope-wise? 6 weeks sounds tight.
Aisha (PM): Iso networking, KMS/HSM integration, audit/event export, admin UI for tenant onboarding. Low-latency region preference. They said willing to sign a contract that increases ARR but need delivery window.
Cam (Data): :thinking: High potential revenue, but heavy infra lift. Suggest a quick RICE baseline before we move people.
Olga (Design): We'll need ~2 sprints for admin flows + docs if we do nontrivial UX. Could ship a CLI/admin API first.
Ethan (Eng): We only have two infra engineers that can touch private deployments this sprint. If we pull them, other initiatives slide.
Ravi (SRE): Also flag: infra upgrade is scheduled during week 4 which could block some work; need to coordinate.
Aisha (PM): Quick RICE calc attempt: Impact=8, Reach=0.05 (5% customers), Confidence=0.6, Effort=8 -> Score = (8*0.05*0.6)/8 = 0.03. Low right now because Reach is small.
Cam (Data): If we productize as a "gov/private package" (marketing + sales enablement) Reach could be 0.15. That changes the math a lot.
Ethan (Eng): Practical proposal: two‑track delivery. 1) MVP: admin API + KMS + basic audit logs; 2) Premium: UI, region tuning, onboarding automation. MVP could be 4–6 weeks if we dedicate 2 eng + 1 SRE.
Olga (Design): MVP UI can be minimal — redirect to a setup doc and basic admin endpoints. Saves 2 sprints of design.
Aisha (PM): Proposed launch criteria for MVP: deployable to customer VPC, KMS integration working, audit logs shipped to their SIEM, E2E tests green, runbook + rollback plan. No fancy UI required.
Lee (Eng Lead): If we accept, what do we deprioritize? We need a swap.
Ethan (Eng): Recommend deprioritizing "prompt-optimizer v2" this quarter (low usage, high dev). That frees up two infra slots.
Cam (Data): Also call out the queue/triage cost — we should timestamp the epic, assign a lead, and not let this become ad-hoc.
Aisha (PM): Agreed. I'll open an epic, add acceptance criteria, and tag owners. Proposed owners: @Ethan, @Olga, @Ravi. We'll also ask Sales to firm up contract terms (SLA + region).
Ravi (SRE): Operationally we need a backup for on-call and a canary region for the rollout. I'll swap rotations but need confirmation by EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New epic created: FINCORP-private-deploy (https://redwood/epics/FINCORP-private-deploy)
Ethan (Eng): Can commit to 6 weeks for MVP only if PMs lock acceptance criteria and Sales signs contract that covers engineering ramp and support costs.
Olga (Design): :thumbsup: I'll draft the minimal admin UI and the onboarding doc tonight.
Cam (Data): Add measurable success metrics to the epic: deployment time, MTTI for audit logs, customer latency delta, and revenue uplift target.
Aisha (PM): Will add metrics and finance inputs; presenting RICE + recommended swap to triage tomorrow 10:00am.
Ethan (Eng): One more ask: include a fallback policy in the runbook — automatic model routing to hosted variant if private falls behind.
Ravi (SRE): Added rollback + fallback note to runbook draft.
Aisha (PM): Thanks all — will circulate the epic link and a short decision doc before triage.
Cam (Data): Also: capture the queue impact as a ticket so product backlog visibility is clear.
Aisha (PM): Done, ticket added to the backlog and linked from the epic.
Lee (Eng Lead): ok — we have a plan and owners. See you at triage. :white_check_mark:
